verdict.rationale: Kit ships an official remote MCP server that lets an AI client read a creator's account, including subscribers, sequences, broadcasts, tags and segments (kit-docs-29, kit-docs-20). The V4 API returns per-broadcast delivery and engagement stats and per-link click performance (kit-docs-36, kit-docs-37), with cursor-paginated list endpoints and API-key or OAuth access (kit-docs-34, kit-docs-30). That covers audiences and campaign results well, but automations are only implied through sequences. Missing for 10: explicit API/MCP read access to visual automations and their live status, account-level or aggregate cross-campaign reporting, and independent hands-on corroboration of an agent pulling and reporting on this data.
